description: Unit tests for the DefaultClusterConfig class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cluster.config package, testing immutability, equality, default values, configured values, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultClusterConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of DefaultClusterConfig.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Loads configuration from the 'cluster-test' resource before any tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultClusterConfig instances are immutable and that Config objects used are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that the equals and hashCode methods of DefaultClusterConfig work as expected using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: gettersReturnDefaultValuesIfNotConfigured
methods.description: Tests that the getters return default values when configuration is not provided.

methods.name: gettersReturnConfiguredValues
methods.description: Tests that the getters return the expected configured values when configuration is present.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method of DefaultClusterConfig includes relevant fields.
